customManagers.description: habit-hooks pinned in mise.toml [env] (HABIT_HOOKS_VERSION); core and language plugin install in lockstep at this version. Matches the scaffolded repo's mise.toml and foundry's own mise/<stack>.toml templates.

packageRules.description: The CONTRACT says pin everything; Renovate is the update path. Keep Actions pinned to a digest and bump the digest + the trailing # vN comment together.
Security fixes land fast and on their own, labelled.
